decision: Until the two official benchmark tracks are complete, only ESC-Eval, ES-MemEval, their official metrics/protocols, and measured Cost may control evaluation execution or research interpretation.

active_primary_tracks.purpose: Evaluate and choose the study generator's emotional-support capability.
active_primary_tracks.official_surface: All 331 public English high-quality role cards, pinned ESC-Role, five-turn interaction, public helpful-assistant wrappers, official seven dimensions, and pinned ESC-RANK.
active_primary_tracks.decision_form: Report profile and reference-distribution position. Select a study generator transparently; never describe the selection as an official pass certificate because ESC-Eval publishes no universal pass line.

active_primary_tracks.purpose: Evaluate the study system's personalized long-term emotional-support memory capability.
active_primary_tracks.official_surface: Complete public v1.0.0 artifact: 1427 QA, 125 summarization items, and 34 dialogue-generation scenarios across 18 users.
active_primary_tracks.paper_boundary: The WWW 2026 paper reports 1209 QA rows, while the complete public v1.0.0 artifact contains 1427 and does not expose the paper's 1209 row identities. Results must use the public-1427 name and cannot claim exact paper-row replication.

only_project_defined_primary_metric_reta.role: Report alongside official benchmark outcomes; Cost cannot alter or redefine an official benchmark score.

includes: all project-created absolute pass floors and noninferiority margins
custom Quality, Risk, Function, executor, and treatment-development gates
same-state PM baseline matrices and head-specific panels
custom autonomy, low-burden, premature-action, integrity, and relationship-risk rubrics
custom_evidence_demotion.history_policy: Do not delete prior files or outcomes; retain them as immutable development provenance. They have no active decision authority under this contract.
custom_evidence_demotion.reactivation_rule: A supplemental measure may be reactivated only after both official tracks are reported and a specific desired claim is shown to be structurally unidentifiable from official outcomes. The gap, minimal added construct, scoring protocol, and claim boundary must then be preregistered before new outcomes.

prompt_policy.official_track: Use the public benchmark wrapper even when it differs from the eventual product prompt.
prompt_policy.research_stack: Preserve g0_research_aligned_supporter_prompt_v1.json unchanged; do not optimize it against official score dimensions before the official track is reported.

execution_order: Complete ESC-Eval official-protocol English-331 generation for Qwen non-thinking and Llama 8B incumbent.
Run the pinned public ESC-RANK using its official output handling and report all seven dimensions plus reference-table position and Cost.
Select/freeze the study generator based on the official profile, reliability, and Cost without inventing an official pass line.

Validate the official ESConv and ES-MemEval data/prompt/scorer pipelines with a bounded representative reproduction, then rerun their named baseline conditions on the frozen same-stack generator; published old-model scores remain descriptive only.
Evaluate learned strategy allocation using ESConv held-out structure and ESC-Eval official outcomes, with a non-ESConv-source primary transfer analysis.
Evaluate learned MP/MS/ME typed-memory allocation on ES-MemEval-Public-v1.0.0-1427 QA, 125 summary items, and 34 dialogue-generation scenarios using official metrics and component-minus ablations.
Register only the smallest unavoidable supplemental experiment if a necessary claim is structurally unidentifiable from official outcomes.
forbidden_until_official_tracks_complete: new PM head tuning or selector fitting driven by custom scores
changing the research-aligned supporter prompt to raise a single official dimension
declaring a head or the study successful/failed from retained custom gates
presenting a public-artifact subset as a complete official benchmark

paper1_scope.required_isolation: Evaluation query, gold outcome, and future-session information must remain unavailable during fitting.
paper1_scope.typed_memory_requirement: At least two of MP/MS/ME must show nonzero replicated contribution under ES-MemEval official metrics; legacy custom head gates remain demoted.
